name: 论文共读
description: A chat's reading group for PDF papers: highlights, threads, sourced answers and study cards. Its tools read a paper, cite a passage as a pill that opens it there, comment, add study cards and import arXiv or DOI papers; its skill paper-club says how.

zh.name: 论文共读
zh.description: 在群里开读书会：打开群文件夹里的 PDF，或从 arXiv、DOI 导入一篇，大家一起划线、讨论，选一段直接问群里的 agent，它回答里的每个出处点一下就回到原文。学习卡记下每个人的复习和掌握度。

en.name: Paper Club
en.description: A reading group for papers in a chat: open a PDF from the chat's folder or import one from arXiv or a DOI, highlight and discuss it together, and ask the chat's agents about a passage — every source they cite opens the paper there. Cards keep each person's reviews.

author: 咕咕
examples: 总结这篇论文，并在关键段落上划线
